top news.title: Apple overhauls Apple Intelligence, with a new architecture built on Apple Foundation Models developed with Google and adapted to run on device and on servers

tweets.author: @firstadopter
tweets.text: WOW.  Apple is now using... NVIDIA GPUs!?!  Let's go.  $AAPL $NVDA $INTC “Now, we are collaborating with Google and NVIDIA to run new Apple Intelligence workloads on Google Cloud, extending our industry-leading PCC privacy commitments to third-party data centers for the first time.”

tweets.author: @film_girl
tweets.text: As I expected, Apple is going to punt the “on-device” story for Apple Intelligence and push towards the “private cloud compute” story for the models that you'll actually want to use. I'm glad on-device isn't going away, but it's clear a hybrid approach is absolutely necessary

tweets.author: @mweinbach
tweets.text: The new Apple Foundation Models used Gemini technology, but these are still Apple models [video]

top news.title: OpenAI confidentially files for an IPO, says it has “not decided on timing yet”, as “there are things we want to do that are likely easier as a private company”

tweets.author: @openainewsroom
tweets.text: We recently submitted a confidential S-1.  We expect it to leak so we're just announcing it.  We have not decided on timing yet; it may be a while because there are things we want to do that are likely easier as a private company.  But it's a complicated set of tradeoffs and this gives us the option to go public sooner if that ends up being best.

tweets.author: @garymarcus
tweets.text: a lot of fools and a lot of money shall soon be parted. [image]

tweets.author: @markgurman
tweets.text: OpenAI files for IPO a few hours after WWDC. Coincidence? No chance.

top news.title: A federal judge blocks President Trump's policy imposing a $100,000 fee for employer H-1B visa applications

tweets.author: @cameron_arcand
tweets.text: WH tells @townhallcom on federal court ruling shooting down $100k H1-B visa fee that “the Administration is confident this order will be reversed on appeal.” Read more:

tweets.author: @danieldimartino
tweets.text: Summary of the H-1B court ruling: The 100K is a “tax” since businesses must pay it and therefore unconstitutional without congress. So why not have the immigrant pay? Because the Immigration and Nationality Act prohibits immigrants from paying fees when sponsored by employers.

tweets.author: @newyorkstateag
tweets.text: We won our case against the Trump administration for trying to destroy the H-1B visa program. Thousands with these visas serve New Yorkers as doctors, teachers, and other skilled workers. I'll keep fighting to protect them and our immigrant communities.
